gaps.gap: No fully comparable all-category national water-withdrawal and consumptive-use inventory after 2015 is present.
gaps.risk_if_ignored: Dashboard users may read 2015 values as current or combine noncomparable modeled products.
gaps.resolution: Use NWAA/PP1894-D time series for covered sectors and label all-category 2015 inventory; ingest future USGS category releases when available.

gaps.gap: No complete, consistent national consumptive-use total covers every sector.
gaps.risk_if_ignored: A fabricated national consumption denominator or misleading sector share.
gaps.resolution: Show covered-sector subtotal and nulls; build a harmonized model only with documented return-flow and consumption methods.

gaps.gap: Current direct withdrawal, consumption, utility-delivered water, and life-cycle water are not reconciled for U.S. plastics.
gaps.risk_if_ignored: False precision in claimed water saved by plastics bans or replacements.
gaps.resolution: Build facility-water inventory for NAICS 325211 and relevant 326 subsectors; add upstream processes and product-service LCAs with scarcity weighting.

gaps.gap: No ranked set of plastic products and service-equivalent alternatives has been modeled.
gaps.risk_if_ignored: A substitute can use more water through farming, washing, energy, or shorter service life.
gaps.resolution: Select priority products; define functional units and reuse counts; model avoidance plus paper/glass/metal/bio-based alternatives by watershed and scenario.

gaps.gap: National data-center estimates are not connected to verified campus-level withdrawals, consumption, cooling systems, utility sources, and seasonal stress.
gaps.risk_if_ignored: Nationally small values hide local conflicts or facility estimates become speculative.
gaps.resolution: Create a facility registry from permits, utility agreements, environmental reviews, company disclosures, and watershed data; preserve unknowns.

gaps.gap: Utility source mixes have different years, legal definitions, and physical-delivery accounting.
gaps.risk_if_ignored: False city rankings and apparent totals above/below 100 percent.
gaps.resolution: Version annual utility mix, distinguish legal entitlement/import accounting from physical source, and add reliability/yield metadata.

gaps.gap: Comparable local saltwater-intrusion projections are absent for many coastal cities and aquifers.
gaps.risk_if_ignored: Sea-level scenarios become unsupported wellfield-failure dates.
gaps.resolution: Ingest calibrated groundwater models, well screens, pumping scenarios, canal stages, vertical land motion, monitoring chloride, and adaptation actions for each aquifer.

gaps.gap: Drought stages, reservoir levels, and restrictions are volatile live data.
gaps.risk_if_ignored: A static research snapshot remains displayed after conditions change.
gaps.resolution: Add official APIs/scrapers, fetched_at, valid_through, stale-state UI, and archived observations.

gaps.gap: No normalized site-specific capital, operating, energy, brine, conveyance, financing, and permitting model is included.
gaps.risk_if_ignored: One facility's cost is generalized nationwide.
gaps.resolution: Build consistent 2026-dollar levelized cost scenarios by seawater/brackish source, salinity, size, energy, disposal, and distance.

gaps.gap: Independent hourly field data linking AWG yield, electricity, humidity, temperature, water quality, and maintenance are sparse.
gaps.risk_if_ignored: Nameplate capacity and lab efficiency are presented as reliable potable yield.
gaps.resolution: Require third-party field trials across humid, temperate, and arid climates with potable treatment and lifecycle cost.

gaps.gap: Affordability, tribal water rights, rural well failure, farmworker exposure, and small-utility capacity are not quantified consistently.
gaps.risk_if_ignored: Engineering portfolios appear viable while shifting costs and failures to vulnerable communities.
gaps.resolution: Add household burden, service shutoff, well depth/failure, rights/access, project cost allocation, and public-health layers.

gaps.gap: Quantity datasets do not fully represent PFAS, nitrate, salinity, harmful algal blooms, industrial discharge, wildfire contamination, or treatment capacity.
gaps.risk_if_ignored: Available water is treated as usable water.
gaps.resolution: Integrate Safe Drinking Water, discharge, groundwater-quality, harmful-algal-bloom, salinity, and treatment-capability datasets.
